resources.string: JARVIS uses this sovereign accessibility service to guard your attention, terminate dopamine loops, and monitor screen perimeter 24/7.

When enabled, JARVIS keeps a short-lived in-memory snapshot of text visible in other apps so it can read it when asked. Password fields are excluded. Text is not uploaded. This service is read-only and never clicks or controls apps.
Sovereign perimeter locked. Screen oversight and cognitive focus active.
